title: Amazon invests another $4B in Anthropic

sources.quote: In Q4 2024, we entered into an agreement and invested $1.3 billion in a third convertible note, and will invest an additional $2.7 billion by Q4 2025.

From Q3 2023 to Q4 2025, we invested $8.0 billion in convertible notes from Anthropic, which are classified as available-for-sale and reported at fair value with unrealized gains and losses included in “Accumulated other comprehensive income (loss)” and as Level 3 assets.

explain: In November 2024 Amazon agreed to put another $4 billion into Anthropic through convertible notes (loans that turn into shares), bringing its total to $8 billion by the end of 2025. Anthropic also made AWS its main partner for training models.
